definition: to support something so it does not fall
description: On a cobbled lane at a street festival at sunset, a young woman in a teal and bronze superhero costume, a visor and tall boots holds up a long metal beam above her head with both hands. She rises from a wide squat until she stands straight with her legs apart, keeping the beam up under a lit metal arch. Behind her a crowd of young people with drinks and food watch and cheer, one man raising his fist, under strings of bulbs over the stalls. A paper lantern and torn red and white bunting lie on the cobbles in front of her.
